attributes.name: Route ID
attributes.definition: Unique identifier of the route within the API.

attributes.name: Segment ID
attributes.definition: Unique identifier of the segment within a route.

attributes.name: Route name
attributes.definition: Human-readable name for the route.

attributes.name: Segment name
attributes.definition: Human-readable name for the segment.

attributes.name: Route description
attributes.definition: Text describing purpose or characteristics of the route.

attributes.name: Segment description
attributes.definition: Text describing characteristics of the segment.

attributes.name: Creation time
attributes.definition: Timestamp when the route was created.

attributes.name: Last update time
attributes.definition: Timestamp when the route was last modified.

attributes.name: Validity period start
attributes.definition: Start of time window for which the route is valid.

attributes.name: Validity period end
attributes.definition: End of time window for which the route is valid.

attributes.name: Version
attributes.definition: Version tag of the route definition.

attributes.name: Source system
attributes.definition: Identifier of the planning system or algorithm that generated the route.

attributes.name: Mission ID
attributes.definition: External mission identifier the route belongs to.

attributes.name: Total length
attributes.definition: Full 2D length of the route geometry.

attributes.name: Segment length
attributes.definition: 2D length of the segment geometry.

attributes.name: Cumulative length at segment start
attributes.definition: Distance from origin to start of this segment.

attributes.name: Minimum altitude/depth
attributes.definition: Lowest altitude or greatest depth along segment. Reference datum is implementation-defined.

attributes.name: Maximum altitude/depth
attributes.definition: Highest altitude or shallowest depth along segment. Reference datum is implementation-defined.

attributes.name: Average altitude/depth
attributes.definition: Mean altitude or depth over the segment. Reference datum is implementation-defined.

attributes.name: Horizontal curvature index
attributes.definition: Measure of curvature of the segment.

attributes.name: Vertical profile type
attributes.definition: Classification of vertical profile of the segment.

attributes.name: Segment type
attributes.definition: Role of the segment within the route.

attributes.name: Planned start time
attributes.definition: Planned time when route execution starts.

attributes.name: Planned arrival time
attributes.definition: Planned time at final destination.

attributes.name: Segment entry time
attributes.definition: Planned time when vehicle enters the segment.

attributes.name: Segment exit time
attributes.definition: Planned time when vehicle leaves the segment.

attributes.name: Segment duration
attributes.definition: Planned duration required to traverse the segment.

attributes.name: Total duration
attributes.definition: Planned overall travel time including holds.

attributes.name: Average speed
attributes.definition: Planned mean speed over segment length.

attributes.name: Maximum speed
attributes.definition: Maximum allowed or expected speed on segment.

attributes.name: Minimum speed
attributes.definition: Minimum allowed speed for safe operation.

attributes.name: Acceleration limit
attributes.definition: Maximum allowed linear acceleration magnitude.

attributes.name: Turn rate limit
attributes.definition: Maximum allowed yaw rate when changing heading.

attributes.name: Hover/loiter duration
attributes.definition: Planned duration for hover or loiter.

attributes.name: Transport mode
attributes.definition: High-level transport mode.

attributes.name: Vehicle class
attributes.definition: Platform category.

attributes.name: Vehicle type
attributes.definition: Specific platform type (e.g., quadcopter, AUV, tracked UGV).

attributes.name: Vehicle dimensions
attributes.definition: Physical envelope for clearance checks.

attributes.name: Vehicle mass
attributes.definition: Total mass at planning time.

attributes.name: Height restriction
attributes.definition: Allowed altitude range over entire route.

attributes.name: Depth restriction
attributes.definition: Allowed depth band for underwater segments, measured below the surface.

attributes.name: Speed restriction
attributes.definition: Route-level maximum allowed speed.

attributes.name: Segment speed restriction
attributes.definition: Segment-level maximum permitted speed.

attributes.name: Maneuverability requirement
attributes.definition: Required maneuvering capability level for the segment.

attributes.name: GNSS dependency
attributes.definition: Indicates if segment assumes GNSS availability.

attributes.name: Communication requirement
attributes.definition: Required communications level for the segment.

attributes.name: Obstacle clearance
attributes.definition: Minimum distance from known obstacles along segment.

attributes.name: Terrain clearance
attributes.definition: Minimum vertical distance between vehicle and terrain.

attributes.name: Safety buffer radius
attributes.definition: Radial buffer around planned path intended to be obstacle-free.

attributes.name: Risk level
attributes.definition: Qualitative or numeric risk level associated with the segment.

attributes.name: No-go proximity
attributes.definition: Minimum distance to nearest no-go zone.

attributes.name: Collision likelihood
attributes.definition: Probability of collision for the segment under stated assumptions.

attributes.name: Redundancy requirement
attributes.definition: Indicates if redundant routing is required.

attributes.name: Emergency exit availability
attributes.definition: Indicates if safe diversion options exist from segment.

attributes.name: Minimum safety altitude/depth
attributes.definition: Safety-driven minimum altitude or maximum depth along segment.

attributes.name: Environment domain
attributes.definition: Primary operating environment.

attributes.name: Surface type
attributes.definition: Dominant surface type along the segment.

attributes.name: Sea state
attributes.definition: Sea state classification (Douglas sea scale, 0-9) affecting marine operations.

attributes.name: Wind/current band
attributes.definition: Range classification of wind or current intensity, as a category label or numeric band index.

attributes.name: Visibility condition
attributes.definition: Assumed visibility condition.

attributes.name: GNSS quality
attributes.definition: Expected GNSS robustness.

attributes.name: Communication coverage
attributes.definition: Expected communications quality.

attributes.name: Initial energy
attributes.definition: Energy/fuel level at route start.

attributes.name: Segment energy
attributes.definition: Estimated energy consumed while traversing the segment.

attributes.name: Cumulative energy
attributes.definition: Total energy consumed up to end of segment.

attributes.name: Minimum required energy
attributes.definition: Minimum energy needed at segment start for safe completion.

attributes.name: Remaining energy
attributes.definition: Predicted energy level at route completion.

attributes.name: Payload mass
attributes.definition: Mass of payload carried.

attributes.name: Payload type
attributes.definition: Type of payload (e.g., sensor, cargo, survey).
